about: Examples of the token estimate and of the token budget's rule (docs/reference/3-context.md, "Token budgets"). The estimate exists on both sides: server/budget.py and macos/Sources/FocusSnapshot/TokenEstimate.swift. server/test_budget.py and macos echofox-tests check every example. counts are the characters of the text by kind (a character is a Unicode scalar; whitespace is Unicode's White_Space). tokens are the estimate with the weights below and with the fallback of a model without weights, the ceiling of the exact decimal sum. take: the first items of costs, greedily, until their sum reaches budget; kept is how many, used their sum.
